description: OTSEGO – State Rep. Eric Lucero visited Kaleidoscope Charter School located in Otsego last Wednesday to meet and discuss civics with several fourth grade classes.“It’s always an honor to be invited to our local schools to meet with students,” Lucero said. “As a former educator myself I always enjoy helping the next generation learn and get motivated about their future.”Three different classes joined together into the same classroom for the visit.
